# TETO-STREAM

> Free, open-source streaming platform for movies, TV shows, anime, and manga.

## About
TETO-STREAM is a React-based web application that provides a catalog and streaming interface for entertainment content. It uses TMDB and AniList APIs for metadata, supports embedded players and proxy-based streaming, and is available as a web app, desktop app (Tauri), and mobile app (Capacitor/Android).

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS
- Desktop: Tauri (Rust)
- Mobile: Capacitor (Android)
- Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB
- APIs: TMDB, AniList GraphQL

## Key Pages
- / — Home (trending movies, TV, anime)
- /movies — Browse movies by genre
- /tv — Browse TV shows by genre
- /anime — Browse anime (AniList)
- /manga — Browse manga (AniList)
- /search — Search across all media
- /download — Download native apps
- /about — About the project
- /blog — News and updates
- /settings — User preferences
- /terms — Terms of Service
- /privacy — Privacy Policy
